narration.text: Why there may be 22,000 species of ants.
Only about 13,800 have been described so far.
Ants became ecologically dominant around 60 million years ago.
They later made up 20 to 40% of fossil insects.
They churn soil and carry seeds into the ground.
Without them, dead matter and pests would pile up.
So some of Earth's key engineers are only millimetres long.
